hook.name: TokiHook
hook.description: Custom curve hook implementing a Pendle-style fixed-rate AMM for Principal Token / underlying token pairs on Uniswap v4. Handles all liquidity operations directly, maintains a TWAP oracle for log-implied rates, supports optional ERC4626 rehypothecation vaults, and gates swaps on both a curator-controlled pause flag and a PT maturity expiry.
